{{Top}}
'''Reedug''' was a popular narcotic in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], grown in the warm climate among the hills of [[Polmanar/Legends|Polmanar]].

At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], reedug farmers rebelled against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the tariffs it placed on their product. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] came to Polmanar's aid by arming guerrilla fighters, and the Empire eventually abandoned its attempted blockade.
